guide.bunnidogs.title: Bunnidogs Guide
guide.bunnidogs.page.2.title: Find a warren
guide.bunnidogs.page.2.body: Look for guava trees and entrance mounds. Follow lit tunnels to Nests. Settlements have one to five trees; cave, Nether and End lines have their own habitats. Maps: page 46. Scouts: page 47.
guide.bunnidogs.page.3.title: Genes and stats
guide.bunnidogs.page.3.body: Each of seven genes has two copies. Dominance picks the visible trait; hidden copies still pass to pups. Bred stat points are separate. Use Calipers to read both.
guide.bunnidogs.page.4.title: Breed a seed
guide.bunnidogs.page.4.body: Feed a guava to each of two ready adults. They drop one seed holding both parents. Its tooltip shows the planned litter, quality and stat drift. The parents then rest.
guide.bunnidogs.page.5.title: Hatch the litter
guide.bunnidogs.page.5.body: Plant a seed on farmland; dispensers plant into air above it. Bone meal speeds growth; hand or dispenser Starlit Dust ripens it. Break the ripe crop to hatch pups. Fortune improves quality. Leave room.
guide.bunnidogs.page.6.title: Guava quality
guide.bunnidogs.page.6.body: Better guavas improve inherited stat gains. Feed both parents: their qualities are averaged. Golden: 1, Diamond: 2, Netherite: 4, Star: 7, Beacon: 12, Dragon Egg: 20.
guide.bunnidogs.page.7.title: Keep a pedigree
guide.bunnidogs.page.7.body: Log animals with a Pedigree Book; Ear Tags label them. Sneak-use with a filled basket in the other hand to log its animal. Normal use opens records. Filter contents by traits/tags or senses>=20; hover the field for syntax.
guide.bunnidogs.page.8.title: Nests and travel
guide.bunnidogs.page.8.body: Adults claim reachable Nests and return at night. Lead one to a free Nest and use it to rehome. Empty-hand Nest use inspects it. Use a compass on a Nest or resident to mark home; the place stays marked if removed.
guide.bunnidogs.page.9.title: Food and troughs
guide.bunnidogs.page.9.body: Guavas suit every line; other foods follow Diet. Fill a trough for healing. Injured adults can eat near their Nest at night; keep food and a safe route within four blocks of home. Sneak-empty withdraws stock.
guide.bunnidogs.page.10.title: Life at home
guide.bunnidogs.page.10.body: Healthy adults visit nearby bells at noon. Ring one to call a daytime visit. Keep it within 12 blocks of home, with walking space. Injury, threats, leads, rides and night interrupt.
guide.bunnidogs.page.11.title: Gentle sampling
guide.bunnidogs.page.11.body: Use a Sampling Syringe on an animal at half health or better. It yields one Tissue Sample without harm; recovery takes five minutes. Sneak-use Calipers for care readiness and timers.
guide.bunnidogs.page.12.title: Wool and whiskers
guide.bunnidogs.page.12.body: Shear a healthy woolly adult for two wool in coat colors. Brush adults at Senses +10 for one whisker. Each needs ten minutes of recovery. Tools wear once; pups yield neither.
guide.bunnidogs.page.13.title: Useful coats
guide.bunnidogs.page.13.body: Expressed ember resists fire and lava; moss prevents Poison; sand prevents cactus damage; void prevents Levitation. Hidden copies give no protection. Other dangers still matter.
guide.bunnidogs.page.14.title: Physical traits
guide.bunnidogs.page.14.body: Hoofed legs halve fall damage. Slate adds 4 armor. Stocky/chonker resist knockback by 15%/30%. Snow walks on powder snow; snow/woolly resist freezing. Glow is self-lit. Hidden traits give no benefit.
guide.bunnidogs.page.15.title: Laboratory
guide.bunnidogs.page.15.body: Put two Tissue Samples on a Genetics Table: sheets, pup forecasts, copy odds and splice plans. Reading spends nothing. Hoppers fill A then B and drain A first; power them to hold samples. Comparators read 0 / 8 / 15.
guide.bunnidogs.page.16.title: Gene Splicer
guide.bunnidogs.page.16.body: Sneak-use to select a gene. Hold a donor sample in the other hand and carry Mutagen. Use on a healthy adult: one donor copy enters that gene. Costs one sample, Mutagen and tool use.
guide.bunnidogs.page.17.title: Stable lines
guide.bunnidogs.page.17.body: Register stable bred adults with matching copies in all seven genes and recorded parents. Use the Registry on an animal, or sneak-use with its filled basket in the other hand. Keeps 24 distinct lines.
guide.bunnidogs.page.18.title: Show Ring
guide.bunnidogs.page.18.body: Lead a stable bred adult to a Judging Stand. Use empty-handed or with a lead. Every stat needs +5 for bronze, +20 for silver, +50 for gold. Sneak-empty use previews; each tier pays only once.
guide.bunnidogs.page.19.title: Material drops
guide.bunnidogs.page.19.body: Death drops follow genes and bred points. Player kills unlock signatures and legends; pups give less. Pelts craft leather, sinew makes string, whiskers make Brushes and marrow makes Mutagen.
guide.bunnidogs.page.20.title: The five legends
guide.bunnidogs.page.20.body: At stat +100, adult player kills can drop a legend. Vitality: Titan Haunch; speed: Gilded Foot; Leap: Moon Sinew; Senses: Listening Shell; Bloom: Everbloom. More points improve the chance.
guide.bunnidogs.page.21.title: Apex ritual
guide.bunnidogs.page.21.body: Craft an Apex Crucible from seven obsidian, a Mutant Marrow and a diamond. Put all five distinct legends on Trophy Pedestals in its ring. Offer a Tissue Sample to choose the boss line.
guide.bunnidogs.page.22.title: The ritual ring
guide.bunnidogs.page.22.body: Use any five slots: three blocks N/E/S/W or two blocks diagonally, at crucible height. Leave dry space above it. Success spends the sample and five legends. The living donor stays safe.
guide.bunnidogs.page.23.title: Apex of the Line
guide.bunnidogs.page.23.body: Watch for its charge: dodge pounces and leave the four-block stomp. Half health enrages it. A player victory drops a crest that reads the original line or stands on a pedestal. Care tools refuse.
guide.bunnidogs.page.24.title: Guava juice
guide.bunnidogs.page.24.body: Craft a guava with a glass bottle. Hold a seed in the main hand and juice in the other, then use the seed to infuse it. The rolled pup genes determine the drink effects. Better seeds improve them.
message.bunnidogs.trough.tending.on: Resident work enabled. Sneak-hoe selects its mode.
message.bunnidogs.trough.tending.off: Resident work disabled. Food storage remains available.
guide.bunnidogs.page.25.title: Trough gardening
guide.bunnidogs.page.25.body: Healthy adults harvest matching food at hoe-enabled troughs, then rest a minute. Bloom +10 grows unripe crops. Diet, filters and mob griefing apply. Berries regrow; cactus pruning: page 57.
guide.bunnidogs.page.26.title: Furnished warrens
guide.bunnidogs.page.26.body: New dens have a trough with two guavas; levels 3-5 may fit a central bell. Grand-tree nurseries may fit an empty Cradle. New farm corners have empty enabled troughs. Use a hoe to enable work on crafted or old troughs.
message.bunnidogs.apex.missing_one: Missing offering: %s. Empty-hand use checks the ring.
message.bunnidogs.apex.missing_many: Missing offering: %s, and %s more. Empty-hand use lists them.

tooltip.bunnidogs.tissue.apex_preview: Main-hand Calipers on an Apex Crucible forecast this line.
guide.bunnidogs.page.27.title: Before the Apex
guide.bunnidogs.page.27.body: Hold Calipers in the main hand and a Tissue Sample in the other. Use an Apex Crucible for health, attacks and defenses. Empty-hand use lists missing offerings. Reading spends nothing.
message.bunnidogs.gardening.ready: ready to search; needs an enabled, unpowered trough, matching food, room and a safe route
message.bunnidogs.gardening.danger: paused by danger, seeking refuge or a recent attack
message.bunnidogs.gardening.outside_home: needs to be within 16 blocks of its Nest
guide.bunnidogs.page.28.title: Living harvests
guide.bunnidogs.page.28.body: Brush healthy adults: glow gives glowstone; starborn at Bloom +20 gives Starlit Dust; moss at Bloom +10 gives moss carpet. Senses +10 adds a whisker. Gather one of each match for one tool use and ten-minute recovery.
guide.bunnidogs.page.29.title: Terrain traits
guide.bunnidogs.page.29.body: Hoofed adults step up one-block ledges and take half fall damage. Fleet legs reduce soul-sand and honey slowing by 25%; lean builds by 50%. Together: 75%. Cobwebs, Slowness and other hazards remain.
guide.bunnidogs.page.30.title: Shore fishing
guide.bunnidogs.page.30.body: Hurt fisher adults hunt nearby cod, salmon or tropical fish. They need a Nest, daylight and a reachable fish. A kill heals 4 HP, then rests 30 seconds. Pufferfish and land prey are excluded.
guide.bunnidogs.page.31.title: Resident needs
guide.bunnidogs.page.31.body: Sneak-use Calipers for a claimed Nest, distance, foods and meal recovery. Healthy adults need no healing. Ready means ready to search, not a promise of nearby food. Reading changes nothing.
guide.bunnidogs.page.32.title: Find refuge
guide.bunnidogs.page.32.body: Non-feral residents retreat from visible threats to a safer dry spot near home. Meals and work pause. Leads and rides take over. Feral lines keep their retaliation. No safe route means no retreat.
guide.bunnidogs.page.33.title: Storm shelter
guide.bunnidogs.page.33.body: Idle adults wait under cover near their Nest during thunderstorms. Leave a dry floor, room to stand and a safe route. Meals, work, danger and player control take priority. Normal rain keeps idle routines.
guide.bunnidogs.page.34.title: Trough automation
guide.bunnidogs.page.34.body: Hoppers fill and drain troughs. Power the hopper to hold food. Stock: one matching stack, up to 16; comparators read 0 empty to 15 full. A hoe toggles gardening. Redstone pauses residents: page 49.
guide.bunnidogs.page.35.title: Bell calls
guide.bunnidogs.page.35.body: Ring a bell within 12 blocks of a Nest to call healthy adults by day. Redstone and projectiles work too. Safe paths, leads and care take priority. Visits: 20 seconds, one-minute rest. Sneak-Calipers: roll call (page 52).
guide.bunnidogs.page.36.title: Fleece colors
guide.bunnidogs.page.36.body: Woolly adults yield two wool in their coat colors. Spotted gives one yellow and one brown. Glow gives cyan; moss green; ember red; void purple. Hidden coats add nothing. Calipers names the ready yield.
message.bunnidogs.trough.filter_set: Reserved for %s with matching components. Food was not consumed.
message.bunnidogs.trough.filter_conflict: Withdraw the different stored food before changing the filter.
message.bunnidogs.trough.filtered: Reserved for %s with matching components. Sneak-empty while empty clears the filter.
message.bunnidogs.trough.filter_cleared: Food filter cleared. This trough accepts any suitable food again.
guide.bunnidogs.page.37.title: Trough filters
guide.bunnidogs.page.37.body: Sneak-use food to reserve a trough for that exact food and its components, without spending it. Hoppers and gardeners obey the filter. Sneak-empty withdraws stock; repeat while empty to clear the filter.
guide.bunnidogs.page.38.title: Care dispensers
guide.bunnidogs.page.38.body: Dispensers use Brushes or Sampling Syringes on one eligible bunnidog ahead per pulse. One tool use; hand and machine share recovery. Collect drops with hoppers. Armadillo brushing still works.

message.bunnidogs.basket.released: Released safely; adults can claim a new Nest.
guide.bunnidogs.page.39.title: Travel Basket
guide.bunnidogs.page.39.body: Craft six planks, leather and a lead into a basket. Pack one calm unled animal; release on clear dry ground. Identity and care rest persist; its old Nest becomes free. Calipers reads it. Stations: 82.

message.bunnidogs.cradle.growing: Stage %s/7; next in %ss. Sneak-empty withdraws and resets growth.

message.bunnidogs.cradle.refused: Hatching was refused. The litter is retained.
message.bunnidogs.cradle.hatched: Hatched %s pups. The Cradle is empty.
guide.bunnidogs.page.41.title: Nursery Cradle
guide.bunnidogs.page.41.body: Craft wool, glass, a Nest and planks into a Nursery Cradle. Insert one seed; a loaded minute adds one stage. Bone meal helps; Starlit Dust ripens it. Sneak-empty withdraws and resets growth. Calipers reads the litter.
guide.bunnidogs.page.42.title: Hatch safely
guide.bunnidogs.page.42.body: Use a ripe Cradle empty-handed or pulse redstone. Clear a dry 3x3 pad ahead with two air blocks. Sneak-Calipers checks it. Hoppers move seeds; comparators read 15 when ripe. Manual-only controls: page 86.
message.bunnidogs.crop.crowded: Too many bunnidogs nearby. The crop stays ripe until there is room.
message.bunnidogs.crop.refunded: Hatching was refused. The original litter seed has been returned.
guide.bunnidogs.page.43.title: Surplus compost
guide.bunnidogs.page.43.body: Bloom +10 adults compost food above an eight-item reserve at hoe-enabled troughs. Place a composter nearby with a safe route. Crop work takes priority. Each job spends one food and rests a minute. Hoppers collect bone meal.
tooltip.bunnidogs.mutagen.nursery: Use on a planted seed or Cradle, or dispense at it; keeps growth
guide.bunnidogs.page.44.title: Treat a litter
guide.bunnidogs.page.44.body: Use or dispense one Mutagen at a planted seed or occupied Cradle. Growth, incubation, parents, quality and item details stay intact. Treated or invalid litters keep the vial. You can treat a ripe litter before hatching.

message.bunnidogs.guarding.ready: ready to search for visible selected hostiles near home; safe routes required
message.bunnidogs.guarding.active: defending near home; sneak-use a bone to disable
guide.bunnidogs.page.45.title: Nest guards
guide.bunnidogs.page.45.body: Sneak-use a bone on a feral adult with a Nest to toggle guarding. No bone is spent. Free, half-healthy guards bite selected hostiles within eight blocks of home. Leads pause them. Calipers reports readiness. They can still be hurt.
guide.bunnidogs.page.46.title: Warren maps
guide.bunnidogs.page.46.body: Journeyman cartographers may sell a Warren Explorer Map for 14 emeralds and a compass. Follow its village marker to a natural Overworld warren. The trade is not guaranteed. Failed searches omit it. Cave dens and End warrens are excluded.

message.bunnidogs.scouting.health: A mineral scout needs at least half health.
message.bunnidogs.scouting.traits: Needs expressed bat ears and at least +10 bred Senses; hidden copies do not qualify.
message.bunnidogs.scouting.combat: Survey paused during combat or refuge.
message.bunnidogs.scouting.ready: ready; sneak-use a compass for nearby ore. At Senses +20, hold a mineral in the other hand to focus.

message.bunnidogs.scouting.marked: Compass marked %s at %s, %s, %s. The place remains marked after mining.
guide.bunnidogs.page.47.title: Mineral scouts
guide.bunnidogs.page.47.body: Sneak-use a compass on a half-healthy bat-eared adult with Senses +10. Marks ore through rock within six blocks. A survey rests 30 seconds, even when empty. Places stay after mining. Focused surveys: page 48.
message.bunnidogs.scouting.focus_require: Focused mineral surveys need at least +%s bred Senses. Clear the mineral from the other hand for a general survey.
guide.bunnidogs.page.48.title: Choose a mineral
guide.bunnidogs.page.48.body: Senses +20 scouts can focus: hold a mineral in the other hand. Raw metals/ingots select their ore; coal, redstone, lapis, gems, quartz or netherite scrap select theirs. No mineral is spent. Every focus shares the same survey rest.
guide.bunnidogs.page.49.title: Pause trough work
guide.bunnidogs.page.49.body: Power a Feeding Trough to pause resident meals, crops and composting. Stock, filters, hoppers and comparator output still work. Remove power to resume at the next search. The hoe keeps its setting. Empty-hand inspection names the pause.
advancement.bunnidogs.standing_watch.des: Ask a feral adult with a Nest to guard its home.
advancement.bunnidogs.quiet_listener.des: Ask a bat-eared adult bred to Senses +10 to mark nearby ore on a compass.
advancement.bunnidogs.discerning_ear.des: Use a mineral cue with a Senses +20 bat-eared scout to find that ore family.
screen.bunnidogs.records.filter_help: Filter contents: tag or trait words; shown:bat, carried:glow, adult, pup; senses>=20, bloom<10 or speed=5. Space-separated terms all match. Clear to restore. Original record numbers and parent links stay intact.
message.bunnidogs.finder.name: Rename a spare Ear Tag to a code such as BD-3F7A2C, then sneak-use Calipers with it in the other hand.
message.bunnidogs.finder.none: %s: no loaded matching animal within %s blocks.
tooltip.bunnidogs.ear_tag.finder: Rename a spare to a code; sneak-use Calipers to find that animal
tooltip.bunnidogs.calipers.finder: Sneak-use the air with a code-named Ear Tag opposite: find nearby matches
guide.bunnidogs.page.51.title: Find a tagged animal
guide.bunnidogs.page.51.body: Rename a spare Ear Tag to a code like BD-3F7A2C. Hold it opposite Calipers; sneak-use the air. Loaded matches within 24 blocks glow ten seconds. Search rest: five seconds. Reusable tag; packed animals are excluded.
message.bunnidogs.home_marker.none: This animal has no claimed Nest to mark.
message.bunnidogs.home_marker.missing: The recorded Nest is missing or outside this world.
message.bunnidogs.census.header: Bell roll call: %s loaded residents, %s injured. Nests within %s blocks; animals within %s.
message.bunnidogs.census.more: %s more loaded residents. The first eight are shown, injured first.
tooltip.bunnidogs.calipers.census: Sneak-use a bell: loaded resident roll call
guide.bunnidogs.page.52.title: Bell roll call
guide.bunnidogs.page.52.body: Sneak-use Calipers on a bell for loaded adults with nearby Nests. Lists tags, health, foods and homes; injured first. Shows up to eight animals within 32 blocks, with Nests within 12. Reading rings no bell and changes nothing.
message.bunnidogs.recovery_rest.health: Only serious injury (below half health) needs rest
message.bunnidogs.recovery_rest.outside_: Must first return inside its home boundary
message.bunnidogs.recovery_rest.ready: Ready to seek a safe spot near its Nest; meals take priority
guide.bunnidogs.page.53.title: Recovery rest
guide.bunnidogs.page.53.body: Adults below half health rest near their Nest instead of strolling by day. Food, danger, storms, breeding and leads take priority. Keep a dry safe route. Rest heals nothing; stock suitable food. Sneak-Calipers reports readiness.
tooltip.bunnidogs.guava.table: Hold while reading a Genetics Table to preview the feed quality
tooltip.bunnidogs.mutagen.table: Hold while reading a Genetics Table to preview treatment without spending it
guide.bunnidogs.page.54.title: Plan a litter
guide.bunnidogs.page.54.body: Read a Genetics Table holding one guava for both parents, or two to average them. Mutagen previews treatment. Cues and samples are kept. Clear hands for plain, untreated plans. Starborn is included. Fortune: page 55.
guide.bunnidogs.page.55.title: Plan the harvest
guide.bunnidogs.page.55.body: Read the table with a Fortune tool in either hand. Uses the highest held level, adding 0.5 quality per level at crop harvest. An opposite guava or Mutagen also applies. Cues stay intact. Cradles get no Fortune bonus.
guide.bunnidogs.page.57.title: Cactus gardens
guide.bunnidogs.page.57.body: Hoe-enable a trough for desert-browser adults. They trim one spare cactus top, leaving lower segments. Keep clear ground and a safe route. Flowers stay intact. Diet, filters, power, protection and shared work rest apply.
guide.bunnidogs.page.58.title: Regional farms
guide.bunnidogs.page.58.body: New farms grow desert cactus, Nether wart, swamp mushrooms, cave glow berries or End chorus. Some fit an empty enabled trough. Stock it for meals. Old settlements keep their plans. End care: 81.
tooltip.bunnidogs.guava.plant: Use beneath leaves to grow a new hanging fruit
guide.bunnidogs.page.59.title: Guava orchards
guide.bunnidogs.page.59.body: Use one plain guava on the underside of leaves to plant green fruit in air. Any leaf type works. Bone meal adds one age; two ripen it. Pick ripe fruit to keep it growing. Shears or Silk Touch recover guava leaves for new orchards.
guide.bunnidogs.page.60.title: Mushroom beds
guide.bunnidogs.page.60.body: Healthy mushroom eaters thin red or brown beds beside an enabled trough. Another living mushroom of the same color must remain within three blocks. Keep mycelium and clear routes. Native spread regrows the patch; work rests a minute.
guide.bunnidogs.page.61.title: Fruit meals
guide.bunnidogs.page.61.body: Injured adult residents eat ripe hanging guavas near home by day. Matching Diets also pick sweet or glow berries. Plants stay to regrow. One meal heals 2 HP and shares the thirty-second food rest. Safe routes and protection apply.
guide.bunnidogs.page.62.title: Sapling stations
guide.bunnidogs.page.62.body: Dispensers plant guava saplings into air over valid soil. Blocked targets keep stock. Grass, podzol and mycelium work. Bone meal tries growth. Lost soil drops one sapling. Give the whole tree loaded space.
guide.bunnidogs.page.63.title: Underground farms
guide.bunnidogs.page.63.body: New five-tree cave and Nether warrens may fit a regional farm: glow berries under a trellis, or wart on soul sand. Plots need no water. A clear corner may fit an empty enabled trough. Existing settlements keep their plans.
guide.bunnidogs.page.64.title: Safe seedbeds
guide.bunnidogs.page.64.body: Plant litter seeds on farmland. If soil changes to dirt, grass, podzol or mycelium, the crop keeps its whole litter and continues growing. Lost support returns the saved seed. Changing soil never hatches it or resets its parents.
guide.bunnidogs.page.65.title: Snow-coat care
guide.bunnidogs.page.65.body: Brush healthy adult snow coats at Bloom +10 in a climate cold enough for snow to gather one snowball. Hidden snow gives none. Whiskers and Starlit Dust can combine. Hand and dispenser brushes share ten-minute rest. Shears gather wool separately.
message.bunnidogs.care.gathering_bonus: Senses +%s: gathers old loose matching food beside enabled troughs.
message.bunnidogs.care.gathering_require: Needs Senses +%s to gather loose food into enabled troughs.
guide.bunnidogs.page.67.title: Loose food meals
guide.bunnidogs.page.67.body: Injured adults eat ordinary loose food near home by day after ten seconds. Diet, pickup delays and owner reservations apply. Upgraded guavas stay. One item heals 2 HP; food rest is thirty seconds. Keep a dry clear route.
guide.bunnidogs.page.68.title: Trough gathering
guide.bunnidogs.page.68.body: Healthy adults at Senses +10 move one old loose matching food into a nearby hoe-enabled trough by day. Diet, filters, power and safe routes apply. Collection shares the one-minute garden rest. Loose meals: page 67.
guide.bunnidogs.page.69.title: Melon beds
guide.bunnidogs.page.69.body: Healthy foragers and omnivores harvest a slice beside a living attached melon stem, near an enabled trough. The stem regrows fruit; decorative melons stay. Slices heal or grow matching lines. Stems: 70. Farms: 78.
guide.bunnidogs.page.70.title: Grow melon stems
guide.bunnidogs.page.70.body: Bloom +10 grows a young melon stem by one age at an enabled trough. No food is made. Mature stems await native fruit growth; leave nearby soil and air. Meadow stores may hold seeds. All jobs share one-minute garden rest.
guide.bunnidogs.page.71.title: Orchard pickers
guide.bunnidogs.page.71.body: A dispenser with shears picks one ripe hanging guava and resets it to green for one tool use. Unripe fruit keeps the tool. Hoppers collect drops; shears still work on animals and beehives. Repair gaps: page 74.
guide.bunnidogs.page.72.title: Habitat meals
guide.bunnidogs.page.72.body: Injured matching lines eat spare cactus tops, extra same-color mushrooms, ripe wart or stem-linked melons near home by day. Growing stock stays. No trough is needed. A meal heals 2 HP and shares thirty-second food rest. Predators: 80.
guide.bunnidogs.page.73.title: Nest signals
guide.bunnidogs.page.73.body: Read a Nest with a comparator: 15 means claimed, 0 means free. The resident can be away or unloaded. Rehoming updates both Nests. Packing into a Travel Basket or death frees the old one.
guide.bunnidogs.page.74.title: Repair a canopy
guide.bunnidogs.page.74.body: A dispenser plants one plain guava into an empty dry gap beneath leaves. Other targets eject the guava as food, so pulse once to repair a canopy. Upgraded guavas never plant fruit. Bone meal grows it; shears pick it.
message.bunnidogs.trough.mode_set: Work: %s (enabled). Hoe: toggle; sneak-hoe: next mode.
message.bunnidogs.care.nursery_bonus: Bloom +%s: Nursery mode spends one plain guava above %s food to tend one Cradle stage
message.bunnidogs.care.nursery_requireme: Breed Bloom to +%s for Nursery work; keep more than %s plain guavas
guide.bunnidogs.page.75.title: Work modes
guide.bunnidogs.page.75.body: Sneak-hoe a trough to cycle Mixed, Garden, Gather, Compost, Nursery and Supply. Normal hoe toggles work; power pauses it. Garden replants. Pause one resident: 85. Specialist jobs: 84.
guide.bunnidogs.page.76.title: Restore a garden
guide.bunnidogs.page.76.body: Garden mode: Bloom +10 residents spend one suitable food above an eight-item reserve to replant a valid gap. Use the plant's normal soil or support. Carrots, guavas and berries are examples. Jobs share one-minute work rest.
guide.bunnidogs.page.77.title: Nursery workers
guide.bunnidogs.page.77.body: Nursery mode: Bloom +20 adults spend one plain guava above an eight-food reserve for one Cradle stage. The whole litter stays. Jobs share garden rest. Players or redstone hatch ripe litters.
guide.bunnidogs.page.78.title: Meadow melon farms
guide.bunnidogs.page.78.body: Fresh five-tree meadow farms mix young melon stems with ordinary crops. Empty dirt spaces allow fruit; a clear corner may fit an enabled trough. Plants grow naturally. Old settlements keep their plans. Garden repair: page 76.
message.bunnidogs.work.header: Trough work: %s (%s). Eligible to search: %s / %s residents within %s blocks.
message.bunnidogs.work.paused: Resident chores paused. Sneak-hoe again to resume; meals and breeding continue.
message.bunnidogs.work.outside_home: trough outside this resident's home area
message.bunnidogs.work.diet: stock or filter does not match this Diet
message.bunnidogs.work.compost_food: needs compostable food above a %s-item reserve
message.bunnidogs.work.full: no room for more matching food
message.bunnidogs.work.hint: Leave a clear route and the required plants, loose food, composter or Cradle nearby.
guide.bunnidogs.page.79.title: Work roll call
guide.bunnidogs.page.79.body: Sneak-use Calipers on a trough for its mode, food, filter and nearby residents. The report explains age, health, home, traits, recovery and stock limits. Ready means eligible to search. Leave a clear route and the right work nearby.
guide.bunnidogs.page.80.title: Safe hunting
guide.bunnidogs.page.80.body: Wounded hunters and fishers follow dry home routes to wild prey. They stop for unsafe terrain, changed homes or protection. Named, leashed and transported animals stay. One kill heals 4 HP and shares thirty-second food rest.
message.bunnidogs.care.chorus_bonus: Bloom +%s: revive spent chorus flowers for one fruit, keeping the plant
message.bunnidogs.care.chorus_requiremen: Breed Bloom to +%s to revive spent chorus flowers
guide.bunnidogs.page.81.title: Chorus gardens
guide.bunnidogs.page.81.body: Bloom +20 chorus eaters revive spent flowers for one fruit. Mixed/Garden troughs store it; injured adults eat it for 2 HP. Living flowers keep their branch age. Leave supported branches and dry paths.
guide.bunnidogs.page.82.title: Basket stations
guide.bunnidogs.page.82.body: A dispenser packs one calm unled bunnidog ahead. Filled baskets release onto clear dry ground. Failed pulses keep the basket. Identity and care rest persist. Each pulse acts once; sort with hoppers.
message.bunnidogs.work.supply_food: needs more than %s ordinary food to supply another trough
message.bunnidogs.care.supplying_bonus: Senses +%s: Supply mode moves one surplus food while keeping %s in reserve
message.bunnidogs.care.supplying_require: Breed Senses to +%s for Supply work; keep more than %s ordinary food
guide.bunnidogs.page.83.title: Supply the troughs
guide.bunnidogs.page.83.body: Supply mode: Senses +20 adults move one ordinary surplus food to a nearby non-Supply trough below eight food, keeping eight at source. Keep both unpowered with dry paths. One job shares the one-minute work rest.
message.bunnidogs.work.resumed: Resident chores resumed when healthy and ready.
message.bunnidogs.gardening.paused: Paused by keeper; sneak-use a hoe on this resident to resume
message.bunnidogs.cradle.manual_only: Manual hatching only. Sneak-hoe to enable redstone; incubation continues.
message.bunnidogs.cradle.redstone_enable: Redstone hatching enabled. Sneak-hoe for manual only; a fresh pulse hatches ripe litters.
message.bunnidogs.cradle.ready_manual: Ripe litter: use empty-handed to hatch. Redstone hatching is disabled.
guide.bunnidogs.page.85.title: Pause a resident
guide.bunnidogs.page.85.body: Sneak-use a hoe on a resident to pause or resume chores, with no wear. Meals, breeding and home routines continue. Pups can keep the preference. Calipers shows the pause; Travel Baskets preserve it.
guide.bunnidogs.page.86.title: Cradle controls
guide.bunnidogs.page.86.body: Sneak-hoe a Cradle for manual-only hatching. Incubation and nursery work continue; ripe litters still hatch by empty-hand use. Re-enable redstone, then send a fresh pulse. Calipers reports the setting.
